page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, page number 266 at top left; main text in one column of verse with headings; an emblem motto ornament at left margin; a catchword "Non" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears at the right and is omitted.

main_text.l: Sin eadem morti soluantur debita, tandem
Glauce, quid assiduè liquidis versaris in vndis?
Cur flumen domus est, & cibus herba
tibi? Naturæ morīque hominum contrarius, optas
Te populus mirans dictitet, Hic vir, hic
est. Mirari non est laudare. Popellus inepta
Miratur: laudant sed bona sola boni.
Et non forte nimis tumere lata:
Et non forte nimis leui retundi:

page.notes: The emblem ornament at the left margin (a stylised woodcut motto with pen-like strokes) is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the facing page is omitted. The word "Non" at lower right is treated as a catchword. Some letters in the verse are uncertain and may be misread (e.g. "Hærens", "Illætrabilis", "Gnarus"). The lower right "Non" is faint and may be a catchword rather than a footnote.
